title: EEG: Continuous gameplay of an 8-bit style video game
description: EEG recordings from 17 participants during continuous gameplay of Escape from Asteroid Axon, an 8-bit style video game. Participants also completed a two-stimulus visual oddball task and a two-doors gambling task. Task triggers are embedded in the EEG files and accompanied by continuous .csv logs of player movement, actions, antagonist position, and loot boxes. The data support analysis of canonical neural events during naturalistic, continuous behavior.
methods_description: Data were collected circa 2015 in the Cognitive Rhythms and Computation Lab at the University of New Mexico. Participants completed a visual oddball task, a gambling task, and the video game, all written in Java. Each task sent triggers to the EEG file and wrote continuous behavioral data to a .csv log file.
